tool_args.rationale: The bridge and flux-conservation signatures suggest coupled dynamics, but the existing measurements are confined to one horizon. A trajectory batch can distinguish transient mechanisms before numerical fitting and fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a saturating algebraic response or coupled thermal model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All seven observations share the same horizon, initial state, and history; they cannot distinguish a steady saturation law from transient coupled dynamics.
Already acquired; it added sink-gradient variation but did not resolve the time dependence.
Its nuisance reading would not resolve the mechanism.
